contexts.text: There put off principles of falsity. AC 1107.
Put off thy shoe (). The shoe = the natural ultimate, which is to be put off.
Death nothing but the putting off of the things of grossest nature...
The Lord completely put off the Maternal.
When He had put off this human. He put on the Divine Human.
Human rational truth cannot put off appearances.
If he were to put off the idea of space and time...
He puts off the old man, and puts on the new.
The plenary putting off of the human...
The idea of a sepulchre is as it were put off...
Old age = to put off what is human, and to put on what is heavenly.
As He put off this human. He put off the appearances also; and put on the infinite and eternal Divine Itself.
Ends for self and the world must be put off, and ends for the neighbour, etc., must be put on. To put off the former, and put on the latter, is impossible... except through media.
When the body has been put off...
No one can put off the life he has acquired from infancy, unless...
External things are put off with the body.
Concupiscences must be put off, and affections of Heaven must be put on. Explained.
They stripped Joseph of his coat () = to dispel and annihilate appearances...
The Celestial of the Spiritual... was the human... which could be put off...
When the external is being put off...
After the putting off of the body...
When made God, He had put off all the human from Mary.
The Lord successively put off the human; and put on the Human from the Divine in Himself. Explained. CanonsNC 22. Redeemer. 9.
Thus could He put off nature... and put on the Divine.
When He had put off the natural degree...
After death, man puts off all that does not agree with his love; and successively puts on the face, tone, speech, gestures, and manners, of his life's love.
When the Lord had glorified His Human, He put off everything of His mother, and put on everything of the Father.
By acts of redemption He put off the human from the mother, and put on the Human from the Father... Illustrated. TCR 103:end.
When your external man is put off...
They stripped him (). To put off (or strip), in the Word, = to bereave of truths.
